{{Top|leg}}
The '''Organium Group''' was an organization<ref name="Tempest Feud">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref> that operated during the [[New Republic era|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> an outpost of the Organium Group of a remote [[Planet/Legends|world]] fell under attack from a band of [[Tempest (spice)|Tempest]] addicts, who set [[Fire/Legends|fire]] to a number of the Group's warehouses and factories, and a group of freelance agents were dispatched to the world to restore order.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
